title: Fix pacman error: you cannot perform this operation unless you are root
summary: pacman installs and updates system software, so only the administrator (root) may run it. Put sudo in front of the command; sudo asks for your own password, not root's.

aliases.text: pacman you cannot perform this operation unless you are root
arch cannot install package not root
pacman error need root arch linux
pacman нельзя выполнить операцию без root
pacman не могу установить пакет нет прав
как установить пакет arch от root

error_patterns: error: you cannot perform this operation unless you are root
prerequisites: Your account is allowed to use sudo (an administrator account)

steps.explain: Check which account you are logged in as. pacman refuses to run as a normal user, so the error appears. The output shows your own user name, not root.
steps.expect: Your own user name, for example alex. It is not root.

steps.explain: Run the same pacman command with sudo in front. sudo runs it as root after asking for your password. Replace <PACKAGE> with the name of the package you want to install.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Name of the package to install from the Arch repositories

steps.expect: sudo asks for your password, then pacman lists the packages it will install and asks 'Proceed with installation? [Y/n]'. Type y and press Enter.

alternatives.explain: Upgrade the whole system instead of installing one package. Use it when the goal is to update packages. It is also run with sudo.
alternatives.expect: pacman refreshes the package list, then shows the packages to upgrade and asks for confirmation. Type y and press Enter.

steps.explain: Check that the package is now installed. pacman -Q prints the installed package name and version. Replace <PACKAGE> with the same name as in the previous step.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Same package name as in the install step

steps.expect: The package name followed by its version, for example 'nano 9.2-1'. If you see 'package ... was not found', the install did not finish.

rollback.explain: Remove the package again if you installed it by mistake. This removes only that package, not the upgrade.

placeholders.name: PACKAGE
placeholders.description: Same package name as in the install step

warnings: Install and upgrade commands change system files. Type your password only when sudo asks for it, and read the package list before you answer y.
sudo pacman -Syu upgrades every installed package. Do not interrupt it; a half-finished upgrade can break the system.
If sudo says 'is not in the sudoers file', your account has no administrator rights. Ask the owner of the computer to add it, or use an administrator account.
pacman -S installs from the package list stored on this computer. If that list is old, run sudo pacman -Syu first to avoid a partial upgrade.
